title: Peer memory changes which agents are consulted without a detected accuracy gain
summary: Matched observations report changed consultation behavior, while the study bounds the downstream answer-accuracy effect as not detected. The null-bound applies to the evaluated tasks and setup and does not prove no effect in other settings.
ai_technology: A persistent-memory mechanism changes peer selection in multi-agent language-model systems.
